packageRules.description: reqwest 0.13's rustls backend unconditionally pulls in aws-lc-rs, which fails to link against musl (undefined reference to __isoc23_sscanf/__isoc23_strtol). Re-enable once aws-lc-rs's musl support improves or reqwest offers a non-aws-lc-rs rustls backend again.
